svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, 47 - 63 Hz, two inputs, two hot-swap supplies
svg.data-power-dc-input: PoE in 43 - 57 V passive or 802.3bt class 6 (management port); DC jack 36 - 57 V; two-pin terminal 36 - 57 V
svg.data-power-rating-label: 100-240 V 50/60 Hz (printed beside the first supply), 36-57 V (printed over the DC inputs)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: brochure: backward compatible with 40 Gigabit, 25 Gigabit, 10 Gigabit and 1 Gigabit connections
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: brochure: two 100 Gigabit QSFP28 ports, backward compatible with 40 Gigabit; no module is included
